scope: End-to-end evaluation of ``Engine.scan`` on scene sets with tile truth.
matching: one-to-one tile pairing at IoU >= 0.5; cards and unidentified outputs both pair
selection: Models and thresholds were frozen on development sets before these sets were scored; no value here was used to select a checkpoint or threshold.
identity_split: identity:heldout covers gallery cards with id % 7 == 0, whose artwork never entered encoder training; the gallery still contains them.
field_visibility: A field target is visible when the list view shows it and its crop lies fully inside the image; values emitted for hidden targets are scored against the card state.
